meaning.FALSIFIED: every failed criterion is listed; the candidate as frozen is not usable for R2.
meaning.INVALID: the run says nothing about the candidate; no rerun without a new authorization.
meaning.NOT_FALSIFIED_ON_THIS_HOLDOUT: the frozen candidate met F1-F4 on this one synthetic holdout. It qualifies NO product use: replay determinism, OD-2 durable records, real-data transfer and R2 contract activation stay separate, unmade decisions.
